selected: repeated synthetic mutation gate after read-only qrexec readiness
why: It advances from transport/auth proof to state-changing reliability while keeping all missions synthetic and enforcing zero-tolerance invariants before any real-Qubes mutation campaign.

comparison.qa: deterministic CI assertions for duplicate mutation, unresolved commit, old-key acceptance, exactly-once attempts, and p95 latency

comparison.approach: jump directly to mutable real-Qubes campaign
comparison.qa: harder to separate VM/policy failures from state-machine failures
comparison.result: deferred until deterministic synthetic gate is green

lessons: Read-only qrexec readiness proves transport/auth stability but not exactly-once mutation semantics.
A single successful mutation is insufficient evidence for restart/replay safety.
Latency budgets belong in the readiness gate so correctness does not hide pathological recovery time.
